description: Defines the rrc_reestablishment_procedure class for handling RRC reestablishment procedures in a 3GPP-based RRC protocol implementation, including methods for security verification, context transfer, and signaling.

classes.name: rrc_reestablishment_procedure
classes.description: Class encapsulating the RRC reestablishment procedure, including security, context transfer, signaling, and fallback handling.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the reestablishment procedure within a coroutine context.

methods.name: is_reestablishment_accepted
methods.description: Checks if the reestablishment request is accepted.

methods.name: verify_security_context
methods.description: Verifies security context and updates keys.

methods.name: transfer_reestablishment_context_and_update_keys
methods.description: Transfers UE context and updates security keys.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Instructs the DU to create SRB1 bearer.
